(D) It is an automorphism.

solution.text:
p p
A field has no nonzero nilpotents, so (u − v) = 0 implies u = v. If (a(t)/b(t)) = t for
nonzero polynomials a, b, then p deg a = 1 + p deg b, an impossibility modulo p. Thus t has
no preimage. Even for a field, infinitude prevents the finite-set argument for surjectivity.
